senses.gloss:
अगोचर a. Imperceptible by the
senses, not obvious, See गोचर;
वाचामगोचरां हर्षावस्थामस्पृशत् Dk. 169
beyond the power of words,
indescribable.
--रं
1 Anything
beyond the cognizance of the senses.
--2 Not being seen or observed, or
known; कथं देवपादानामगोचरेणैवं
क्रियते H. 2 without the knowledge of;
˚तां गतान् Pt. 2.
--3 Brahma;
अगोचरे वागिव चोपरेमे Ki. 17. 11.

अगोता Ved. Want of cows or
rays or praise.

अगोपा a. Ved. Without a
cowherd; पशुर्नैति स्वयुरगोपाः Rv. 2. 4. 7.

अगोरुध a. Ved. Not disdaining
praise.

अगोह्य a. Not to be concealed or
covered, bright.
